text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018. March 26, 2018 Councillor Ainslie, during the morning session of the meeting, wished Councillor Ford a happy birthday. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Peter Wallace, City Manager, to come forward to address Council on the retirement of John Livey, Deputy City Manager. Mr. Wallace spoke of Mr. Livey's accomplishments during his time at the City of Toronto. Mayor Tory came forward and acknowledged Mr. Livey's remarkable career and thanked him for his dedicated public service. On behalf of City Council, Mayor Tory wish John Livey a happy retirement.
